hook.name: BrickHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 2% WETH fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, accumulates fees in a pot, and periodically deploys the pot to add permanent floor liquidity (35%), buy-and-burn BRICK tokens (27%), fund operations (36.8%), and reward the triggering keeper (1.2%). Liquidity removal is blocked for all addresses except the designated seeder.
